sql.query: SELECT u.id userId,COALESCE(NULLIF(u.displayName,''),NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ',u.fName,u.lName),''),u.email) userName,u.email,COALESCE(ut.chatAvailability,'available') chatAvailability,ut.chatStatusMessage,CASE WHEN cp.isActive=1 THEN c.id ELSE NULL END conversationId,COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_chat_messages msg WHERE cp.isActive=1 AND msg.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND msg.conversationId=c.id AND msg.senderUserId<>:currentUser AND msg.isDeleted=0 AND msg.id>COALESCE(cp.lastReadMessageId,0)),0) unreadCount,(SELECT latest.messageCiphertext FROM tbl_chat_messages latest WHERE cp.isActive=1 AND latest.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND latest.conversationId=c.id AND latest.isDeleted=0 ORDER BY latest.id DESC LIMIT 1) messageCiphertext,(SELECT latest.messageIv FROM tbl_chat_messages latest WHERE cp.isActive=1 AND latest.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND latest.conversationId=c.id AND latest.isDeleted=0 ORDER BY latest.id DESC LIMIT 1) messageIv,(SELECT latest.messageAuthTag FROM tbl_chat_messages latest WHERE cp.isActive=1 AND latest.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND latest.conversationId=c.id AND latest.isDeleted=0 ORDER BY latest.id DESC LIMIT 1) messageAuthTag,(SELECT latest.messageKeyVersion FROM tbl_chat_messages latest WHERE cp.isActive=1 AND latest.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND latest.conversationId=c.id AND latest.isDeleted=0 ORDER BY latest.id DESC LIMIT 1) messageKeyVersion,CASE WHEN cp.isActive=1 THEN c.id ELSE NULL END messageConversationId,(SELECT latest.senderUserId FROM tbl_chat_messages latest WHERE cp.isActive=1 AND latest.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND latest.conversationId=c.id AND latest.isDeleted=0 ORDER BY latest.id DESC LIMIT 1) lastSenderUserId,(SELECT MAX(lastMessage.createdDate) FROM tbl_chat_messages lastMessage WHERE cp.isActive=1 AND lastMessage.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND lastMessage.conversationId=c.id AND lastMessage.isDeleted=0) lastMessageDate FROM tbl_user_tenants ut INNER JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=ut.userId AND u.isActive=1 LEFT JOIN tbl_chat_conversations c ON c.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND c.conversationType='direct' AND c.directKey=CONCAT(LEAST(:currentUser2,u.id),'-',GREATEST(:currentUser3,u.id)) AND c.isActive=1 LEFT JOIN tbl_chat_participants cp ON cp.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND cp.conversationId=c.id AND cp.userId=:currentUser4 WHERE ut.tenantId=:tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active' AND ut.userId<>:currentUser5 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='TEAM_CHAT' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND tm.status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles roleMembership INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=roleMembership.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='chat.view' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE roleMembership.userId=:currentUser6 AND roleMembership.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND roleMembership.isActive=1) ORDER BY CASE WHEN lastMessageDate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,lastMessageDate DESC,userName
